assignment: Close B-PACKET-RENDERER by exposing a reusable participant-rendering entry point that reuses the approved Illinois family composition.

reproduction.workerFailureBeforeChange: Worker failure: render_failed Pleading document primary_filing has no pleading caption.

diagnosis.summary: The worker adapter is not calling the wrong existing composition path, and the composer is not missing a caption rule. The approved Illinois documents were never composed through composeGradeAPacket at all, so before this change there was no function anywhere that could produce them for one participant.
specificationToComposerToRenderer: data/record-clearing/packet-specifications/IL-felony-prostitution-relief.v1.json declares both documents presentation=pleading, outputStrategy=custom_pleading, but its sections are the generic kinds caption / static / static / signature_block (primary_filing) and caption / static / court_signature_block (proposed_order).

composer.ts composeSection emits a pleading_caption block only for section.kind === 'pleading_caption' (composer.ts:304). For kind 'caption' it emits heading + labelled + rule; for 'static' heading + paragraph; for 'signature_block' heading + signature. So composeGradeAPacket returns a pleading-presentation document made of guidance blocks.

renderer.ts drawPleadingDocument requires a pleading_caption block in a pleading document and throws 'Pleading document primary_filing has no pleading caption.' (renderer.ts:138-140). The guard is correct: a pleading without a caption is not a pleading.

The family builder scripts/build-census-v1-il-prostitution-j-vacate-set.mjs never used the Grade-A composer. Its own composedBody() built the approved page text as plain lines and renderComposedPdf() drew them with its own pdf-lib text renderer; runFamily() assembled those pages into the committed fixtures. There was no exported pure composition, and no Grade-A block structure existed for this family anywhere.

Consequence, and the reason the caption is not the whole defect: the specification's static sections DESCRIBE the motion ('The movant asks under 20 ILCS 2630/5.2(j)(3) to vacate and expunge the prior Class 4 felony prostitution conviction identified from the court record...') rather than reproducing it. Teaching composer.ts to emit a pleading_caption for this specification would have made the renderer succeed while handing a participant descriptive prose that is not the approved motion text — a green render over unapproved content.
diagnosis.conclusion: A participant-rendering entry point was genuinely missing, and the missing piece is family composition, not a caption flag.

decision.chosen: Preferred option: a pure participant-rendering entry point built on the family's own approved composition, extracted into one module that the fixture builder itself now uses.

rejected.option: Make composer.ts emit pleading_caption generically, opt-in by specification field.
rejected.why: It would fix the throw and not the packet. The IL specification's sections summarise the documents; composing from them yields body text no legal review approved. The caption was the symptom.

rejected.option: Return the fixed canonical fixture PDF.
rejected.why: Explicitly forbidden, and it is not personalization: every participant would receive Jordan Avery Reyes's copy.

rejected.option: Weaken or bypass the renderer caption guard.
rejected.why: Explicitly forbidden. The guard is the only thing standing between a participant and a pleading with no caption.

contentFidelityDecision.why: The family's production-field-map records those six as REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING refusals ('a case fact on a record the platform has not seen'), and the specification's own gapNotes say the approved documents leave them as blanks copied from the court record. The entry point therefore writes exactly the four facts the approved family writes and preserves every approved dotted blank, even where the verified snapshot happens to carry a value. Writing a verified county or case number into the caption would be a new write against an approved refusal — a packet-content decision that belongs to the Captain, not to this lane.
contentFidelityDecision.captionEffect: The caption carries the participant's own case-caption facts to the extent the approved family writes them: the defendant/movant is this participant, by name, with the approved DEFENDANT-MOVANT designation; the county and case-number slots stay the approved blanks.

layoutAdaptationsDisclosed: The Grade-A pleading renderer is not the family's fixture renderer, so the participant PDF is a different rendering of the same sentences; byte equality with the approved fixtures is not claimed and is not possible.

The caption's case-number slot uses a 20-dot blank instead of the fixture line's 44-dot blank, because the shared renderer repeats that slot in every continuation header, where a 44-dot blank plus the parenthetical overran the document title. The approved explanation ('Case No. (the EXISTING criminal case number)') is printed in the caption note directly under the caption. The fixture text is unchanged and still uses the 44-dot line.

The fixture-only trailer line 'Route: obligation:track-pathway:IL:...' is build evidence, not filing text, and is not printed on the participant copy; the Grade-A renderer stamps its own provenance page.

The caption's defendant designation reads block.defendantRole ?? 'DEFENDANT/PETITIONER', so the Illinois caption can print its approved DEFENDANT-MOVANT. The pleading-caption guard is untouched; the default is unchanged and byte-proved below.
The isolated test of the entry point, two synthetic participants, no database, no authority, no real data.

tests.proves: Two synthetic participants compose and RENDER: real %PDF bytes, 5 pages each. Distinct facts produce distinct bytes and distinct text with neither participant's facts in the other's document. Identical inputs are byte-deterministic. Each pleading carries exactly one pleading_caption whose defendant is that participant. The approved sentences are readable in the rendered bytes; the six approved blanks stay blank. Every refusal fires. A caption naming no defendantRole still prints DEFENDANT/PETITIONER.
